body:
Hey Raman, you can use `transformItems` to ignore the refinements you set initially in [connectCurrentRefinements](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/connectors/connectCurrentRefinements.html). Can you give some code of what you tried already? 

P.S. this repository is for the Vanilla InstantSearch.js, https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch is for React and React Native :), please follow up there if there's more questions!
